summary: Genesis Part 1 is available free in ASA. Missions lead into Corrupted Master Controller; Tides of Fortune is optional paid content rather than a map-access requirement.
sharedPreparation: Record difficulty, Single Player Settings and mods before comparing your army with official-server videos.
Start with Gamma; measure health, ammunition and saddle losses before raising difficulty. Total creature level is not a substitute for actual stats.
Keep a breeding pair and spare equipment at base. Fully heal the team and rehearse whistle groups before summoning.
Check tribute, permitted creatures, timer and rewards at the current ASA terminal; do not copy ASE requirements.
Assign Code-Key collection and Codebreaker delivery separately from enemy control. Rehearse returning to cover and the team before collecting on foot.
Pack spare armor, Medical Brews and ranged ammunition for the survivor phases; keep the arena movement lanes clear.

steps.title: 1 · Build biome equipment kits
steps.reason: Separate cold, heat and diving equipment. Establish supplies in several biomes before taking difficult missions.

steps.title: 2 · Missions and the Final Test
steps.reason: Complete the current required missions, then select The Final Test through HLN-A. Check the ASA completion requirement in your save rather than importing an Evolved mission count.

steps.title: 3 · Corrupted Master Controller
steps.reason: Kill corrupted enemies, collect their Code-Keys on foot and deposit them at the Codebreaker. Deposits remove protection and create boss damage windows; keep runners protected while the team controls enemies.

loadouts.entry: A tame team controls enemies while survivors complete the Code-Key objectives.
loadouts.warning: No numeric army thresholds are verified here. Check current encounter eligibility and your save settings.

options.title: Enemy-control team + protected key runner
options.team: Eligible combat tames hold the enemy group; a survivor collects and delivers Code-Keys with ranged backup and spare armor.
options.why: The current controller reference separates tame combat from on-foot key collection. Positioning and deposits advance the encounter.
options.play: Stay close enough to the controlled enemy group to collect drops. Deposit at the Codebreaker, avoid being cornered and use cover against the controller’s beam.
options.confidence: Current shared Genesis Wiki mechanics reference; ASA access is established, but a specific ASA army composition and minimum stats are not independently verified.
